name: mizuki-bot
description: Mizuki — WhatsApp community bot with AI, admin, media, and minigame commands

scripts.db:backup: npm run build && node dist/tools/database.js backup
scripts.db:list: npm run build && node dist/tools/database.js list
scripts.db:check: npm run build && node dist/tools/database.js check
scripts.db:verify: npm run build && node dist/tools/database.js verify
scripts.db:restore: npm run build && node dist/tools/database.js restore
